title: Local well-posedness for fourth-order nonlinear dispersive systems on the one-dimensional torus under structural conditions
summary: We study local well-posedness of the initial value problem for a class of fourth-order nonlinear dispersive systems on the one-dimensional torus. The main difficulty comes from the loss of derivatives in the nonlinear terms. By introducing suitable structural conditions that compensate for derivative loss through cancellation mechanisms, and constructing modified energies via gauge-type transformations combined with a diagonalization procedure, we establish local well-posedness in high-regularity Sobolev spaces.
